metadata.question: Does the urban area extent in Jakarta (centered at 6.2°S, 106.8°E) increase between 1989 and 2004?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Location: Jakarta at 6.2°S, 106.8°E (Point(-106.8, -6.2)) - Need to create a buffer around this point to analyze urban extent - Time periods: 1989 and 2004 - Collections: Landsat 5 for both periods (1984-2013 coverage) - Use Landsat 5 Surface Reflectance: "LANDSAT/LT05/C02/T1_L2" 2. Masking strategy: - Apply cloud masking using QA_PIXEL band - Use NDBI (Normalized Difference Built-up Index) or NDVI to detect urban areas - Urban areas typically have high NDBI or low NDVI values 3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero vs Null/Error: - Valid Zero: If urban area is genuinely 0 or decreased, but we have valid pixels - C1: No images found for either period - C2: Images exist but no valid pixels after cloud masking - C3: Calculation returns None/NaN - Compare urban extent between the two periods to answer A (increase) or B (no increase/decrease) ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const jakarta = ee.Geometry.Point([106.8, -6.2]); const region = jakarta.buffer(15000); // 15km radius for analysis // 2. Cloud masking function function maskL5sr(image) { const qaMask = image.select('QA_PIXEL').bitwiseAnd(parseInt('11111', 2)).eq(0); const saturationMask = image.select('QA_RADSAT').eq(0); return image.updateMask(qaMask).updateMask(saturationMask) .multiply(0.0000275).add(-0.2); } // 3. Data Acquisition for 1989 let col1989 = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LT05/C02/T1_L2') .filterBounds(region) .filterDate('1989-01-01', '1989-12-31') .map(maskL5sr); const size1989 = await col1989.size().getInfo(); console.log(`1989 Images: ${size1989}`); if (size1989 === 0) { console.log("No data for 1989."); console.log("C1"); return; } // 4. Data Acquisition for 2004 let col2004 = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LT05/C02/T1_L2') .filterBounds(region) .filterDate('2004-01-01', '2004-12-31') .map(maskL5sr); const size2004 = await col2004.size().getInfo(); console.log(`2004 Images: ${size2004}`); if (size2004 === 0) { console.log("No data for 2004."); console.log("C1"); return; } // 5. Create median composites const img1989 = col1989.median(); const img2004 = col2004.median(); // 6. Calculate NDBI (Built-up index): (SWIR1 - NIR) / (SWIR1 + NIR) const ndbi1989 = img1989.normalizedDifference(['SR_B5', 'SR_B4']).rename('NDBI'); const ndbi2004 = img2004.normalizedDifference(['SR_B5', 'SR_B4']).rename('NDBI'); // 7. Threshold for urban areas (NDBI > 0) const urban1989 = ndbi1989.gt(0); const urban2004 = ndbi2004.gt(0); // 8. Check pixel counts const count1989 = await urban1989.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: region, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('NDBI').getInfo(); if (count1989 === 0 || count1989 === null) { console.log("No valid pixels for 1989 after masking."); console.log("C2"); return; } const count2004 = await urban2004.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: region, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('NDBI').getInfo(); if (count2004 === 0 || count2004 === null) { console.log("No valid pixels for 2004 after masking."); console.log("C2"); return; } // 9. Calculate urban area (sum of urban pixels * pixel area) const urbanArea1989 = await urban1989.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: region, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('NDBI').getInfo(); const urbanArea2004 = await urban2004.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: region, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('NDBI').getInfo(); // 10. Validation if (urbanArea1989 === null || urbanArea2004 === null) { console.log("Calculation failed (null result)."); console.log("C3"); return; } console.log(`1989 Urban pixels: ${urbanArea1989.toFixed(0)}, Valid count: ${count1989}`); console.log(`2004 Urban pixels: ${urbanArea2004.toFixed(0)}, Valid count: ${count2004}`); const increase = urbanArea2004 > urbanArea1989; const percentChange = ((urbanArea2004 - urbanArea1989) / urbanArea1989 * 100).toFixed(1); console.log(`Change: ${percentChange}%`); if (increase) { console.log("A"); } else { console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
